name: Stax Payments

evidence.gateway: F02: merchant processing and gateway; the merchant sells its own goods and services
evidence.billing: F14: recurring invoices charge a stored card or ACH automatically when autopay is set
evidence.links: F16: no-code hosted pages, payment links, buttons and QR codes

line: US and Canadian payment platform for cards, invoices, and recurring billing.

free.text: Plans start at $99/month; online fee is $0.15/payment plus interchange

cells.payout: Direct Pay next day if approved; Connect 2–5 business days

fee.math: The provider fee for online card payments, where the card isn't present, is $0.15 per payment, plus interchange (the base card fee). No percentage markup is advertised.
Stax Pay sign-up is offered to US and Canadian merchants, so UK businesses can't sign up.
